description_en: Cancels a running data migration task
description_zh: 取消正在运行的数据迁移任务
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch cancel-task --instance-id es-cn-nif1q9o8r00080000 --task-type MigrateData --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelTask

parameters.help_en: The task type. Set this parameter to MigrateData, which indicates a data migration task
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型，固定为MigrateData，表示数据迁移任务
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

Result.description_en:
The result. Valid values:

true: The task is canceled.
false: The task failed to be canceled
Result.description_zh:
返回结果：

true：取消任务成功
false：取消任务失败
